out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL DOOR SWEEP AT BASE OF BACK DOOR TO PREVENT ENTRY TO PEST. EMAIL EHS ON COMPLETION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean equipment/utensils (SINGLE SERVICE CUPS) were found stored at the UNDER HANDWASH AND PREP SINK IN FRONT SERVICE AREA AND EXPOSED TO DRIPS.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): STORE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS IN BACK HALLWAY/STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO STORE UTENSILS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.
